WITH s1 AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref AS zoneref, st.healtheval AS healtheval,
         AVG(CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref, st.healtheval
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM s1
)
SELECT s1.zoneref, s1.healtheval, s1.avg_ratio, s1.cnt, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall_avg AS diff
FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
WHERE s1.avg_ratio > s2.overall_avg
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
